identity.title: Chemistry of a newly detected circumbinary disk in Ophiuchus

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present high-angular-resolution (0.4$''$, $\sim$60 AU) observations of C$^{17}$O, H$^{13}$CO$^{+}$, C$^{34}$S, SO$_{2}$, C$_{2}$H and c$-$C$_{3}$H$_{2}$ molecular transitions with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA)

evidence.quote: The distance was determined to be 147.3 $\pm$ 3.4 pc to L1689 as a whole and 151.2 $\pm$ 2.0 pc to IRS67AB specifically; in this paper, we adopt the latter.

question.value: Is there a circumbinary disk around the Class I proto-binary Oph-IRS67AB, and what are its kinematics, chemistry, mass and temperature structure?

evidence.quote: The purpose of this paper is to present the detection of a circumbinary disk around the system Oph-IRS67 and analyse its chemical and physical structure.

analysis_steps.goal: Measure continuum structure and source positions

method.value: 2D Gaussian fits to both peaks; deconvolved size of disk-like structure; inclination from toy thin circular model

evidence.quote: The position and integrated flux of each source are obtained by fitting two-dimensional (2D) Gaussians to both peaks

assumptions.value: Thin circular structure gives inclination ~80 deg

evidence.quote: Assuming a toy model for a thin and circular structure, an inclination of $\sim$ 80$\ensuremath{^\circ}$

analysis_steps.goal: Moment maps, spectra and channel maps of lines

method.value: Moment 0/1 maps; spectra extracted over 1 pixel (0.1''x0.1''); channel maps; two-component Gaussian for SO2

evidence.quote: Each spectrum was extracted over 1 pixel, that is, 0.1$''$ $\times$ 0.1$''$.
the central component of the spectra of both species is fitted with a Gaussian and the values are listed in Table

method.value: Peak emission per channel via imfit; fit v∝r^-0.5 and v∝r^-1 to points >1.7 km/s along PA=234 deg

evidence.quote: the peak emission for each channel is obtained through the CASA task `imfit`.

key_parameters.value: Centre at geometric centre; inclination 80 deg

evidence.quote: the central (0,0) position corresponds to the location of the geometric centre
assuming an inclination of 80$\ensuremath{^\circ}$

fitting.value: reduced chi2 compared; central mass derived

evidence.quote: This fact is highlighted by their reduced *$\chi^{2}$* values, listed in Table [1](#table:PIV).

validation.value: Test with source B as centre gave chi2_red > 10; perpendicular PV cut shows no infall

evidence.quote: resulting in *$\chi^{2}_\mathrm{red}$* values higher than 10 for both fits

analysis_steps.goal: Derive dust and gas masses and CO abundance

method.value: Optically thin dust mass from 0.87 mm flux; gas mass from C17O 3-2 integrated intensity; CO abundance by inverting gas-mass equation with gas-to-dust 100

evidence.quote: The dust and gas masses are calculated from the continuum emission (Fig. [1](#fig:continuum)) and from the integrated intensity of C$^{17}$O *J*=3$-$2

key_parameters.value: C17O integrated over 20 km/s, 5.31 ± 0.01 Jy km/s above 5 sigma

evidence.quote: obtaining a value of 5.31 $\pm$ 0.01 Jy km s$^{-1}$ for *S$_{\nu}$* times the velocity interval

assumptions.value: Dust T=30 K, Ossenkopf & Henning opacity, gas-to-dust 100, C17O/CO=4.5e-4 and CO/H2=2.7e-4

evidence.quote: By assuming a C$^{17}$O abundance with respect to CO of 4.5 $\times$ 10$^{-4}$ (cite: Penzias1981)

validation.value: CO abundance compared to canonical 2.7e-4 across temperatures

evidence.quote: We note that for all of the temperatures used in the calculations, CO abundances are comparable to the canonical value of 2.7 $\times$ 10$^{-4}$.

analysis_steps.goal: Estimate optical depth, column densities and abundances

method.value: Non-LTE RADEX at source B, n(H2)=1e7 cm-3, Tkin=30 and 100 K, b=FWHM; abundance ratios vs CO compared with IRAS 16293

evidence.quote: assuming a H$_{2}$ number density of 1 $\times$ 10$^{7}$ cm$^{-3}$ (collision partner), two kinetic temperatures (*T$_\mathrm{kin}$*) of 30 and 100 K
Assuming standard isotope ratios for C$^{17}$O ($^{16}$O/$^{17}$O = 2005) and H$^{13}$CO$^{+}$ ($^{12}$C/$^{13}$C = 69) from (cite: Wilson1999).

validation.value: Density varied by factor of 10 to test column density sensitivity

evidence.quote: If we change the H$_{2}$ density by a factor of 10, the C$^{17}$O column density remains constant
The calibration and imaging were done in CASA

used_for.value: Non-LTE optical depth and column densities

evidence.quote: The statistical equilibrium radiative transfer code (cite: vanderTak2007) is used to estimate the optical depth ($\tau$) and column densities
The separation between sources A and B is 0.71$''$ $\pm$ 0.01$''$ (107 $\pm$ 2 AU).
the central mass associated with the infalling fit is 3.6 $\pm$ 0.3 M$_{\odot}$
a value of 1.1 $\times$ 10$^{-2}$ *M$_{\odot}$* is obtained for the total mass
a dust mass of 1.1 $\times$ 10$^{-4}$ *M$_{\odot}$* is derived

findings_qualitative.value: C2H and c-C3H2 trace a high-density region offset ~430 AU, enriched in carbon chain molecules; SO2 compact only around source B

evidence.quote: Two further molecular species, C$_{2}$H and c$-$C$_{3}$H$_{2}$, trace a higher-density region which is spatially offset from the sources ($\sim$430 AU).

claims.experiment: Continuum and C17O/H13CO+ kinematics with PV fits
claims.result: Flattened 620 AU structure; Keplerian fit gives 2.2 Msun, but infall fit not excluded
claims.finding: Circumbinary disk detected, Keplerian on <200 AU scales

evidence.quote: Molecular emission and kinematic studies prove the existence and first detection of the circumbinary disk associated with the system Oph-IRS67.

claims.hypothesis: CO is frozen out in the disk midplane
claims.experiment: Compare CO abundance from C17O and dust mass with canonical value
claims.result: Abundances comparable to 2.7e-4 at all temperatures

evidence.quote: Inferred CO abundances with respect to H$_{2}$ are comparable to the canonical ISM value of 2.7 $\times$ 10$^{-4}$

claims.hypothesis: Complex organics such as methanol are present
claims.experiment: Search for CH3OH 7k-6k and RADEX upper limit
claims.finding: Low methanol consistent with extended disk flattening density profile

evidence.quote: The lack of methanol emission suggests an upper limit between 10$^{-10}$ and 10$^{-9}$ for the abundance of CH$_{3}$OH.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: High-density region as centrifugal barrier rejected because infall mass inconsistent; outflow cavity, spiral arms, infalling envelope remain possible

evidence.quote: thus a centrifugal barrier cannot explain the presence of the high-density region in Oph-IRS67.

limitations_admitted.value: Neither Keplerian nor infalling fit can be discarded from the PV analysis

evidence.quote: but neither of them can be discarded by this PV analysis

referee_caveats_inferred: PV fits use imfit peaks with reduced chi2 of 3-15, so Keplerian versus infall is weakly constrained
Masses depend on assumed dust temperature, opacity, isotopic ratios and gas-to-dust ratio
RADEX abundances at one density and temperature; SO2 poorly constrained
Single configuration with limited uv coverage; flux recovery not discussed
